user.title: Add Pico(s)
user.description: Select one or more Pico remotes to add. Only unconfigured Lutron Pico devices are listed.

data_description.device_ids: Pick several when they should all behave identically, e.g. multiple remotes for the same stairway light — their entities, timing, and behavior are then configured once and shared. All selected must be the same Pico type; the type is detected automatically from the hardware.

entities.title: What do these Picos control?
entities.description: Fill in the entities for the ONE domain this entry's Pico(s) control, and leave the rest empty. If you selected more than one Pico, they all share this configuration.

buttons.title: Scene buttons
buttons.description: Assign one or more actions to each button. A button left empty does nothing when pressed. At least one button must be configured.

error.single_domain_required: Fill in exactly one of the fields above — the one domain this Pico controls — and leave the rest empty.
error.buttons_required: Configure at least one button with actions.
error.mixed_pico_types: Select devices of only one Pico type — the devices you picked aren't all the same type.

abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured Lutron Pico remotes were found. Make sure the Lutron Caséta integration is set up and that the Pico isn't already configured.

init.title: What would you like to edit?
init.description: Jump straight to one section and save as soon as it's done — or start from Devices to redo the full setup from scratch.

devices.title: Edit Pico(s) in this entry
devices.description: Add or remove Picos from this entry. Only Picos of this entry's type ({pico_type}) that aren't claimed by another entry are offered; at least one must remain selected. Ones in the same room as a Pico already here are marked "Recommended" and listed first. The rest of this entry's configuration is shared by every Pico selected here.

entities.title: What do these Picos control?
entities.description: Fill in the entities for the ONE domain this entry's Pico(s) control, and leave the rest empty. If this entry has more than one Pico, they all share this configuration.

options.title: Timing & behavior
options.description: Fine-tune timing and behavior. Applies to every Pico in this entry.

accent_light.title: Accent light
accent_light.description: Optional (P2B, 2B, and 3BRL only): pick an accent light (e.g. a ring or edge light) to enable dual-light mode. ON switches to the Lights configured above; OFF switches to this accent light. The two are never on at the same time. Leave empty to disable dual-light mode.

accent_light_appearance.title: Accent light appearance (preset {preset_number})
accent_light_appearance.description: Choose what the accent light looks like for preset {preset_number}. Repeated OFF taps cycle through every preset you add, in order.

data_description.accent_light_effect: Read from the first accent light's supported effects. Pick 'No effect' to use the color or white temperature below instead.
data_description.accent_light_color_mode: Choose 'Color' for the RGB color below, or 'White temperature' for the Kelvin value below. Only used when no effect is selected.
data_description.next_action: 'Try it' turns the accent light(s) on right now with what's filled in above and re-shows this step. 'Save and add another preset' keeps this one and starts the next. 'Remove this preset' (only shown for a preset that already exists) drops it instead of keeping it.

light_presets.title: Light presets (preset {preset_number})
light_presets.description: Optional (3BRL only, and only without an accent light — see the previous step). Configure preset {preset_number} of one or more appearances STOP can cycle through.

data_description.cycle_light_presets: Have STOP cycle through saved appearances instead of doing nothing, or running the STOP actions configured on the next step — a Pico uses one or the other, not both.
data_description.light_preset_effect: Read from the first configured light's supported effects. Pick 'No effect' to use the color or white temperature below instead.
data_description.light_preset_color_mode: Choose 'Color' for the RGB color below, or 'White temperature' for the Kelvin value below. Only used when no effect is selected.
data_description.next_action: 'Try it' applies this preset to the light(s) right now and re-shows this step. 'Save and add another preset' keeps this one and starts the next — STOP wraps back to the first after the last. 'Remove this preset' (only shown for a preset that already exists) drops it instead of keeping it.

custom_actions.title: Custom actions
custom_actions.description: All optional. A button can use hold actions or double-tap actions, not both.

data_description.middle_button: Runs on every STOP tap, replacing the default STOP behavior for this domain. Unavailable if STOP light-preset cycling is enabled on the previous step.
data_description.on_hold: Runs in addition to the ON button's normal press behavior once held past the hold time.
data_description.off_hold: Runs in addition to the OFF button's normal press behavior once held past the hold time.
data_description.stop_hold: Runs in addition to the STOP button's normal press behavior once held past the hold time.
data_description.on_double_tap: Replaces the ON button's normal tap on two quick taps. Delays resolving a single tap slightly, to confirm a second one didn't follow.
data_description.off_double_tap: Replaces the OFF button's normal tap on two quick taps. Delays resolving a single tap slightly, to confirm a second one didn't follow.
data_description.stop_double_tap: Replaces the STOP button's normal tap on two quick taps. Delays resolving a single tap slightly, to confirm a second one didn't follow.
data_description.test_action: Runs the picked action immediately with what's filled in now, without leaving this step or saving.

buttons.title: Scene buttons
buttons.description: Assign one or more actions to each button. A button left empty does nothing when pressed. At least one button must be configured.

scene_hold_actions.title: Scene hold and double-tap actions
scene_hold_actions.description: All optional. A button can use hold actions or double-tap actions, not both.

data_description.button_1_hold: Runs in addition to Button 1's scene action once held past the hold time.
data_description.button_1_double_tap: Replaces Button 1's scene action on two quick taps. Delays resolving a single tap slightly, to confirm a second one didn't follow.
data_description.button_2_hold: Runs in addition to Button 2's scene action once held past the hold time.
data_description.button_2_double_tap: Replaces Button 2's scene action on two quick taps. Delays resolving a single tap slightly, to confirm a second one didn't follow.
data_description.button_3_hold: Runs in addition to Button 3's scene action once held past the hold time.
data_description.button_3_double_tap: Replaces Button 3's scene action on two quick taps. Delays resolving a single tap slightly, to confirm a second one didn't follow.
data_description.off_hold: Runs in addition to the Off button's scene action once held past the hold time.
data_description.off_double_tap: Replaces the Off button's scene action on two quick taps. Delays resolving a single tap slightly, to confirm a second one didn't follow.
data_description.test_action: Runs the picked action immediately with what's filled in now, without leaving this step or saving.

error.single_domain_required: Fill in exactly one of the fields above — the one domain this Pico controls — and leave the rest empty.
error.buttons_required: Configure at least one button with actions.
error.at_least_one_device_required: Select at least one Pico to keep in this entry.
error.hold_and_double_tap_conflict: A button can use hold actions or double-tap actions, not both — remove one before continuing.
error.test_action_failed: The test action failed to run. Check the log for details; your other entries here were kept.
error.accent_light_overlap: An accent light can't also be one of the lights configured above — pick a different accent light, or remove it from the Lights step.
error.middle_button_light_presets_conflict: STOP actions can't be combined with the light-preset cycling configured on the previous step — clear one or the other before continuing.

pico_type_mismatch.title: Pico hardware type mismatch
pico_type_mismatch.description: Device `{device_id}` is configured in Pico Link as a `{configured_type}`, but {reason}. Its button events are being ignored until this is resolved. Confirm the Pico's type in its Pico Link entry, or remove and re-add it if the physical device changed.

pico_removed.title: Pico removed from the Lutron bridge
pico_removed.description: "{title}" in Pico Link references device `{device_id}`, which no longer exists in Home Assistant's device registry — it may have been removed or re-paired on the Lutron bridge. Its button presses will do nothing until this is resolved. Edit or remove this Pico Link entry to match your current hardware.

pico_entity_missing.title: Pico Link entity no longer exists
pico_entity_missing.description: "{title}" in Pico Link references {entities}, which no longer exist in Home Assistant's entity registry — they may have been deleted or renamed. Button presses that target them will do nothing until this is resolved. Edit this Pico Link entry to point at the correct entities.
